R36 #1205 merged; full release CI 45502194066 passed on a90a45fb4; production promotion rolled back on worker health 503 (#1210). Fix #1210 merged and targeted tests (355) plus release CI 45547061109 passed; deploy job skipped, successful re-promotion unverified. Both current CodeBuild statuses green. No accepted 8+/10 live Fargate site, real checkout/forms, three owner handoffs or unattended recovery proof.

SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
